answer: A reputation escrow with slashing can anchor an agent economy against sybils. Every agent posts a 500-token bond and 30 days of verified history before its votes count. First, a newcomer stakes and quarantines while a lagoon of established peers vouches for it, signature by signature. Second, each honest attestation deepens its score like pigment soaking into canvas. Third, proven collusion burns the bond instantly, so a dune of 10,000 fakes costs 5,000,000 tokens and a month to build, then evaporates. Like a beach club: pricey memberships, and the tide swallows sneak-ins.
